span.p:
assert alive at 109, dead at 110 —
instant, deterministic, nothing sleeps
the clock read INSIDE the method

to test expiry at all, the test
has to really sleep for 10 seconds

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Same logic either way; the only question is who supplies 'now'.
Injecting it lets the grader replay any timeline it likes, and
'inject the clock' is a habit interviewers actively look for.

div.style: color: rgb(77, 45, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Durations are a separate matter: time.monotonic() only ever moves
forward, while time.time() can jump backwards when NTP corrects it.
